title: Repair a shallow snapshot copy
prompt: A Snapshot copied from another must own independent readings. set(0,v) changes only that snapshot. Indexes passed to get/set are valid; copying an empty Snapshot is valid.
signature: class Snapshot: Snapshot(vector<int>), int get(size_t) const, void set(size_t,int)

tests.label: Copy independence
tests.hint: The copy must have its own elements.

tests.label: Assignment independence
tests.hint: Copy assignment must also be independent.

tests.label: Empty copy
tests.hint: An empty vector can be copied.

hints: A vector held by value already knows how to make independent copies.
explanation: The compiler-generated vector copy copies elements. A shared_ptr copy copies an owner of the same vector instead, which breaks a value-snapshot promise.
